title: A Saurian Lover's Ordinary Days
description: You encounter someone surrounded by three Saurians out in the wild...

mainQuestExcel.title: A Saurian Lover's Ordinary Days
mainQuestExcel.description: You encounter someone surrounded by three Saurians out in the wild...

dialogs.text: My dear, your enthusiasm is... quite overwhelming. Phew... Shall we have some ice to cool our heads, then talk about this later?
Shrawrr—!
You hear a scream at first, followed by the thud of something heavy falling to the ground. Then, all that's left are Saurian cries...
Huh!? Is that person alright?
Ugh, he's surrounded... We can't see what's going on at all...
Shall we try a view from above?
Rawr!
#Hmm. Seems like {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} wants to give it a try — go on then, little buddy!
Grawr...
Uh, something's not right. Is that person dead— Ugh, no, no, pish posh! Maybe he just passed out. But still, we can't just stand by and do nothing!
Um, could you three please let us through?
Shrar! Grawr!
Mmrawr...?
Rawr!
Whoa, they won't let us through at all... What's going on? Considering what that person said before, he might know these Saurians...
If only we had more clues...
...Rawr!
#Hmm? Have you discovered something, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}? Come on, let's keep up!
(There's a diary over here...)
(Read the first part.)
"...Today's a rainy day. I prepared "Ripple" his favorite <color=#00E1FFFF>Sour Sauce Ceviche</color>. His look of satisfaction made it all worthwhile..."
"...Even if he's swimming in a leisurely manner, the moment I proffer some of that <color=#00E1FFFF>Sour Sauce Ceviche</color>... Whoosh! Out he pops from the water, and in such lovely form, too..."
"...I would never doubt his affection for me. Only, perhaps, that he might love <color=#00E1FFFF>the ceviche</color> more..."
(Read the second part.)
"...Big round sparkling eyes, curly tail and cheery cries... Jade, oh, Jade, is there a cuter Saurian in this world than you...?"
"...You have never once been cheated, nor never once doubted, as if all life might become your friend and enjoy a wonderful time playing with you..."
"...Were I not so busy, I'd love to play with you all day, watching you dart through woods swimming in mottled sunlight, like a child of the wind, a spirit oh so carefree..."
(Read the third part.)
"...I've crossed mountains and valleys just to search for your whereabouts. If you truly wished not to see me, you could have departed..."
"...But you had consideration for my pace, stopping every so often, even collecting so much Grainfruit on my behalf, not to mention those shiny stones..."
"...Oh Marigold, my lovely Marigold, only I know the tender heart that lies beneath your hard shell. To be a fighter so fierce was never your intent..."
(Alright, time to stop reading...)

flow.stepDescription: Find a way to distract the Saurians together with your Saurian companion

So... Ripple's this Koholasaur's name, huh? Guess the Sour Sauce Ceviche in the pot must've been for him.
"...Big round sparkling eyes, curly tail and cheery cries... Jade, oh, Jade, is there a cuter Saurian in this world than you...?"

#Ah, so that little Yumkasaur is named "Jade." Playful, too, sounds like. Maybe you two could be friends, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}.
Rawr!
"...I've crossed mountains and valleys just to search for your whereabouts. If you truly wished not to see me, you could have departed..."
"...But you had consideration for my pace, stopping every so often, even collecting so much Grainfruit on my behalf, not to mention those shiny stones..."
"...Oh Marigold, my lovely Marigold, only I know the tender heart that lies beneath your hard shell. To be a fighter so fierce was never your intent..."
Err, so Marigold's that grumpy Tepetlisaurus, then? Call Paimon blind, but she sure doesn't see how that one counts as "tender"!
Anyway, back on topic. So these three Saurians are... his friends? Why'd they knock him unconscious and surround him, then?
Let's get him out first and ask questions later.
Yeah, that's true. If only we could get them to make way... Hang on, didn't the diary say that Ripple fancies Sour Sauce Ceviche? There's some in camp, so maybe we can use it as a lure!
#As for Jade... Let's send {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} to go make a friend, shall we?
#Great idea! Jade's the fun-loving sort, so {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} just needs to lead 'er off somewhere.
Rawr! Raaaawr!
#See, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}'s excited about the plan too! But perhaps the simplest and least wasteful way would be to use the Sour Sauce Ceviche, right?
We could duel Marigold.
#Err, let's resolve this by more peaceful means, shall we? Like getting {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} to lure the fun-loving Jade away...

flow.stepDescription: Bring the Sour Sauce Ceviche from the camp
Place the Sour Sauce Ceviche in a suitable location

dialogs.text: Hehe, looks like he was attracted by the scent of the food.
#The gap's not large enough, though. Could you help us lure Jade away, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}?
Rawr! Raaaawr!
Nice! We'll leave it to you, then!
#Let's go check on the guy and see if he's okay once {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} leads Jade off, alright?

flow.stepDescription: Wait for your Saurian buddy to lure the Yumkasaurus away

After being defeated, the Tepetlisaurus named "Marigold" drills into the ground and hides only who-knows-where. You take the chance to check on the injured person...
No obvious wounds... Hey, are you alright? Can you hear Paimon?
...Hmm? Marigold? Ah, you gentle soul. You're concerned about me, aren't you? Worry not. I've been training myself to play with you without any worries...
#Hey, Paimon's Paimon, y'hear? Not some Marigold! {NICKNAME}, do you think he might have hurt his head in the fall?
With any luck, his head will clear up soon.
Wait. You're not Marigold. What's going on? What happened to me?
You tell him of how he was surrounded by the three Saurians and knocked down by Marigold...
Ah, so that's what happened. Sorry for the trouble. The name's Icayo. As you can see, I'm an adventurer who loves chasing Saurians... and who sometimes winds up being chased by them.
I had a spell of ill-health that resulted in my being bedridden for a while. Not only did my stamina decline greatly during that time, but I wasn't able to meet them on the regular either...
To have been surrounded by them even before making it to camp... Ah, how fortunate I am, to be one so fretted over.
You're a real positive thinker.
Anyway, we had a bit of a... tussle with Marigold in our rush to save you...
Ah, nothing to worry about. I imagine that was no different from any other game to her. She's probably off sulking somewhere over the loss.
Despite appearances, she's got a delicate soul. I'll go comfort her later, so again, don't you worry.
Alright then. Looks like you're fine. Guess we worried for nothing, but Paimon's glad you're okay all the same.
And I'm grateful for that. Ah, yes. While this isn't of much value... Please, take this Sour Sauce Ceviche recipe of mine, would you?
#Ripple loves this dish — maybe your companion, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}, might too!
Roooah... Rawr!
#Hmm? Wanna give it a try, eh? No need to worry, {NICKNAME} will make some for you!
Rawr!
Is that how it is...?
That would be a problem...
